name: ai-proposal-writer-anna
tagline: AI Proposal & RFP Intelligence Workspace: RFP Shredder, Compliance Matrix, Word/PDF Exports & Dynamic CPQ.
description:
AI Proposal Writer 2.0 is an enterprise-grade AI Proposal Creation, RFP Response, and Commercial Deal Workspace purpose-built for digital agencies, consultancies, freelance developers, and professional service teams.

Transform complex multi-page client solicitations and briefs into high-converting, fully compliant proposals with Anna's native AI sampling, automated RFP requirements shredding, live 2-way compliance matrices, grounded company knowledge base, deterministic CPQ pricing, and multi-format exports (Microsoft Word .docx, Vector PDF, Markdown, and Standalone Pitch HTML).

### 2.0 Enterprise Intelligence Capabilities

1. AI RFP Shredder & Clause Extractor:
- Parses unstructured RFP documents (.txt, .md, .docx text extract, emails) to detect mandatory compliance language ('shall', 'must', 'will', technical constraints, deadlines, and evaluation criteria).

2. Live 2-Way RFP Compliance Matrix:
- Maps extracted requirements directly to proposal sections, flags coverage gaps, and enables 1-click 'Inject Compliance Clause' to eliminate disqualification risks. Export to CSV for audit reviews.

3. Company Knowledge Base & Context Grounder (Lightweight RAG):
- Stores verified agency case studies, security credentials (SOC2, HIPAA), team profiles, and standard warranties in local Anna Storage, grounding proposal generation in real facts.

4. Multi-Format Enterprise Export Suite:
- One-click native Microsoft Word (.docx) export with styled headings and tables, pixel-perfect Vector A4 PDF, GitHub-flavored Markdown, and standalone offline HTML presentations.

5. Interactive Client Presentation & Dynamic CPQ:
- Web presentation mode where clients can toggle optional service add-ons or tiers with immediate deterministic recalculation before digital sign-off.

6. Digital E-Signatures & Audit Trail Certificate:
- Tamper-evident digital signatures with interactive drawing canvas and typed calligraphy styles. Generates cryptographic Certificate ID and timestamp.

7. AI Deal Win-Probability & Sales Health Scorecard:
- Predictive sales analytics computing 0-100% win probability, commercial deal health score, and AI win actions.

8. AI Contract Red-Flag & Scope-Creep Scanner:
- Automated legal vulnerability scan detecting scope drift, client review stalling, premature IP transfers, and third-party liabilities.

9. Interactive Client ROI & Economic Surplus Calculator:
- Real-time quantitative economic modeling calculating net ROI %, payback horizon, and labor savings.

10. AI Sales Follow-Up Cadence & Outreach Sequences:
- 5-stage automated sales follow-up email sequence customized with client variables and mailto triggers.

11. Multi-Currency Live FX Converter & International Billing:
- Instant conversion across 9 global currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, AED, SGD, JPY, INR) with volatility buffers.

12. Deal Pipeline CRM & Kanban Board:
- Switch seamlessly between Table View and Visual Kanban Pipeline (Drafting, Internal Review, Sent, Won/Accepted, Declined, Archived).
